recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片為富細胞、左移的顆粒球系增生，並有嗜鹼性球與嗜酸性球（B、C），呈 CML 樣貌；但核型（D）未見費城染色體，而 FISH（E、F）仍顯示 BCR::ABL1 融合訊號位於 der(9) 上，提示隱匿性插入或複雜易位造成的 Ph 陰性 CML。
features: Panel A: hypercellular aspirate particle with abundant cellular trails
Panels B-C: granulocytic proliferation across maturation stages (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands) with basophils and eosinophils
Panel D: G-banded karyotype without a visible Philadelphia chromosome (apparently normal 46,XY)
Panel E: interphase/metaphase dual-color FISH with fusion signals in nuclei
Panel F: metaphase FISH localizing a BCR::ABL1 fusion signal to der(9), with both chromosome 22 homologs labeled
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears are hypercellular with a granulocytic proliferation showing the full spectrum of maturation, accompanied by basophils and eosinophils, a picture typical of chronic myeloid leukemia. Conventional karyotype does not show a Philadelphia chromosome. Dual-color BCR/ABL1 FISH nevertheless demonstrates fusion signals, and metaphase FISH localizes the fusion to a derivative chromosome 9 rather than chromosome 22. Findings are consistent with Philadelphia-negative, BCR::ABL1-positive CML arising through a cryptic insertion or complex rearrangement; RT-PCR for transcript type is recommended for monitoring.

ddx.vs: aCML has marked dysgranulopoiesis without basophilia and is BCR::ABL1-negative, whereas FISH here shows a BCR::ABL1 fusion.
CNL shows predominantly mature neutrophils with few precursors, no basophilia, CSF3R mutation and absence of BCR::ABL1.
Reactive neutrophilia has toxic granulation, no basophilia and no clonal BCR::ABL1 fusion.
Classic cases show a visible Ph chromosome on karyotype with fusion on der(22), while here the karyotype is Ph-negative and fusion localizes to der(9).
